# read_llm_file_tool

> Read the contents of an existing LlmFile by ID.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=read_llm_file_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Read the contents of an existing LlmFile by ID. Documents and text files come
back as text (extracted where needed). IMAGES come back as ACTUAL VIEWABLE
IMAGES you can look at — not base64 you have to decode. Other binary files
(audio, video) come back as METADATA ONLY — their bytes are not readable and are never returned.

CROSS-TENANT: a file shared with you from another tenant — directly, via a shared
conversation's attachments, or via a shared directory — resolves automatically when
the id is not in your own tenant.

LONG FILES ARE PAGED. Text content comes back at most 12000 characters per
read (what fits under the tool-result cap). Every text read returns total_chars, offset, next_offset and
truncated; when truncated is true, call again with offset: next_offset (how_to_continue spells it out) until
next_offset is null. Pages are consecutive slices of the one content string — no gaps, no overlaps. To read
by LINE instead, pass line_start (1-based) and optionally line_count: the response adds total_lines, line_end
and next_line_start. An offset past the end returns empty content with next_offset: null.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `llm_file_id` | integer | yes | The ID of the LlmFile to read (required) |
| `offset` | integer | no | Character position to start the text content at (0-based; default 0). Use next_offset from the previous read to continue. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Most characters of text content to return (1-12000; default 12000, the most that fits under the tool-result cap). |
| `line_start` | integer | no | Read text content by line: the 1-based line to start at. Overrides offset. |
| `line_count` | integer | no | With line_start: how many lines to return (default: as many as fit under limit). |

## Example

```json
{"name": "read_llm_file_tool", "arguments": {"llm_file_id": 3699}}
```

Documents and text files come back as extracted text; images come back as viewable
image content; audio and video return metadata only.

## Gotchas

- **Find the id first** with [`list_llm_files_tool`](list_llm_files_tool.md) (`title_search`)
  rather than guessing.
- **Shared files resolve automatically** — directly shared, attached to a shared
  conversation, or a public file inside a shared directory (the folder rule,
  [docs/26](../26-llm-file-system.md#the-folder-rule-one-rule-every-door--2026-10-29-engagement-workspace-plan-w1)).
  A private file under a shared directory is "not found"; a public file you reached but
  may not open is "not shared with you".
